_about: The definer functions the site's role (dog_app) can run that check no actor, each with why that is fine, or the open risk it is. Read by test/redteam-catalog.test.js (redteam/catalog.js): a function missing here fails the build; an entry for a function that no longer needs one fails it too, so the list stays true. Reasons from the independent review of the web app, Nov 10, checked by Claude. Remove an open entry in the same PR that fixes its risk.
